## Summary
P0.13 builds the **§18 comparative-benchmark data layer + deterministic scorer set** — everything the wave runner (P0.14) scores with, with no product UI. It lands as a new package **`@rhema/benchmark`** (runs beside `evals/`; the scorer + schema code is the *publishable methodology* of REQ-EVAL-18, while corpus content stays in the enclave) plus migration `0013`.

This ticket **owns** the benchmark's data schemas and scorer implementations; P0.14 orchestrates arms/waves over them and must not re-implement scoring. Deterministic scorers only — LLM judges are P0.14 (C-g).

Implements ticket [`docs/tickets/14_P0.13__benchmark-enclave-and-scorers.md`](docs/tickets/14_P0.13__benchmark-enclave-and-scorers.md); spec §18 (REQ-EVAL-1…20). Stacked on `stevevitali/p0-12-revision-obligations`.

## What changed
- **`packages/db/migrations/0013_benchmark_enclave.sql`** — 9 global (non-tenant, not RLS-forced) benchmark tables + a dedicated `rhema_benchmark` role + a wave-admission trigger. `packages/db/src/schema/benchmark.ts` mirrors them (schema-parity).
- **`packages/benchmark/`** — the new package:
  - `enclave.ts` — access-logged corpus/gold store (DI'd blob backend; log-before-return); `provider-verification.ts` — the no-training verification gate.
  - `corpus.ts` / `wave.ts` / `arm-runs.ts` — corpus + contamination intake, rotation, wave admission, memorization-probe exclusion, the run-ledger join.
  - `gold.ts` / `iaa.ts` — gold intake + adjudication + per-draft IAA.
  - `scorers/` — anchoring, severity-calibration, recall-fp, second-read, voice, meaning-diff, economics, diversity, style-control; `stats.ts` primitives; `power.ts`.
  - `fixture.ts` / `report-guard.ts` — shared fixture format + dev-set headline guard.

## Design decisions
- **Enclave isolation is layered**: a dedicated `rhema_benchmark` role (product roles get **zero** grants on the enclave tables), a blob keyspace (`benchmark/enclave/*`) distinct from the tenant object layout, and an append-only access log every read funnels through. No product/fixture code path can resolve corpus content.
- **AC2 is a DB trigger** (like the credit-cap invariant), so "a draft missing any REQ-EVAL-2 field cannot be admitted" is enforced at the kernel, not by convention. It also bars a dev-set draft from a scored wave (REQ-EVAL-1).
- **Voice scorer consumes feature vectors + bands** rather than importing `@rhema/measure` (a skeleton today) — a clean seam; extraction is measure's future job, the meaning-diff half is owned here.
- **Economics runs under the benchmark reporting role**: `usage_records` is FORCE-RLS and a wave's runs span workspaces, so the cost/latency join reads under `rhema_benchmark` with `SELECT` on `usage_records` + `BYPASSRLS` (a read-only cross-run reporting read of the meter of record).
- **REQ-EVAL-3 verification is an enforceable seam** (`assertProviderTransmissible`, default-deny), not a doc convention, so P0.14's transmission path has machinery to gate on.

## Verification
- Whole-repo green gate: `turbo build lint typecheck` = **93/93**; `pnpm test` = **132 files / 894 tests**; protocol-markers + licenses OK.
- `@rhema/benchmark`: **66 tests** (pure-logic hand-computed + PGlite DB). Two independent fresh-context reviews (Staff-Engineer design + spec gap analysis) run and closed: economics role/RLS (MAJOR), shared-`run_id` fanout (MINOR), and the REQ-EVAL-3 machinery + evals-reuse gaps.

## Acceptance criteria → evidence
| AC (all deterministic) | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Enclave access: every read leaves a log row; no public/fixture path resolves content (REQ-EVAL-3) | `enclave.ts` log-before-return; `enclave.test.ts` (one row/read, separate keyspace, only `rhema_benchmark` granted) |
| A draft missing any REQ-EVAL-2 evidence field cannot be admitted to a wave | trigger `assert_wave_draft_contamination` (0013); `corpus-wave.test.ts` rejects each missing field |
| IAA verified vs hand-computed fixture; below-floor drafts flagged (REQ-EVAL-4) | `iaa.ts` (κ=4/11 hand-checked); `iaa.test.ts` |
| Scorers reproduce hand-computed values on a synthetic-flaw fixture (dev-only) | `scorers.test.ts` (labeled scorer-development-only) |
| Voice: laundered fixture doesn't move the meaning diff; every dropped Tier-1 claim traces or violates (REQ-EVAL-12; C-e) | `meaning-diff.ts`; `voice.test.ts` |
| Dev-set flag: a wave report render with a dev-set draft in a headline table fails | `report-guard.ts`; `report-guard.test.ts` + DB-backed guard |

**Requirement IDs stamped:** REQ-EVAL-1, -2 (machinery), -3 (machinery; written provider verification is a human row), -4 (tooling), -5, -12, -13, -14, -20 (with P0.14).
